description.value: City Centre Stores Ltd. is a supermarket serving the community of Queen Charlotte City (Daajing Giids) on Haida Gwaii, one of British Columbia's most remote and spectacular cycling destinations. For touring cyclists making the journey to this island archipelago, it represents a critical resupply point in an area with very limited retail options. The store was verified open as recently as July 2024 and is noted as wheelchair accessible.
